request: I want to build an app for my book club. We pick a book each month and everyone leaves a short review with a rating out of five.

operations.intent: Lists all books picked so far; where a new monthly book is added Works with the Book record described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Book detail, Sign in / Sign up. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.

Shows one book and all its reviews; where a signed-in member leaves their own review Works with the Member and Book and Review records described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Library, Sign in / Sign up. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.

Email/password authentication for members Works with the Member record described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Sibling pages in this app: Library, Book detail. Follow docs/CONVENTIONS.md; docs/BRIEF.md says what this app deliberately does not do.
